plays.description: Hurts floats a completion into Tennessee territory. DB records 27 yards; commentary says 26.
Catches a dump-off short of the sticks and takes a hit; defender's name is cut off after Cody.
Catches a slant for eight yards and a first down against an extra pass rusher.
Catches a pass for first-and-goal near the seven after a tempo snap.
Hurts' end-zone pass intended for D.Smith is intercepted by Hooker, who returns it to Philadelphia's 10.
Spins away from pressure and scrambles toward the end zone, going out at the one.
Scores on a fourth-and-goal sneak with help from his tight ends.
Catches a first-down dump-off in the flat.
Catches a middle-of-the-field pass for a first down at Tennessee's 40.
Holds onto a completion against five-man pressure for a first down at the 25.
Scoops up a low outside throw for nine yards.
Runs from the 11 through a middle hole and pushes inside the five; Cedric Gray is mentioned at contact.
Scores Philadelphia's first touchdown on a short middle run; commentary credits patience, power and blocking push.
Runs behind multiple blockers for 13 yards into Philadelphia territory when Tennessee needs one.
Backpedals and gets rid of the ball with a flag thrown against Tennessee; penalty and pass result are unspecified.
Finds space for a sideline completion and a first down at the 46.
Scrambles and slides about two yards short of the line to gain as Tennessee drops into coverage.
plays.coverage_scheme: drops into coverage; specific scheme unknown
plays.defender_beaten: Cedric Gray (commentary identifies him at the stop)

plays.description: Catches a pass for a first down.
Stumbles in the backfield and is stopped by Stackhouse.
Gets open for a third-and-long conversion after Hurts pumps and throws with Jeffery Simmons bearing down.
Catches a touchdown behind Amani Hooker after Hurts buys time. Commentary says the route structure occupies that side of the defense.
Catches Ward's throw for a first down and more on third-and-long; receiver and distance are established by the matching DB sequence.
Bustes through after a quick-release pass, completing Tennessee's second consecutive big gain.
Receives a conservative rushing call late in the half; the gain is not stated.
Makes a field goal to end the first half.
Catches a fluttering pass near the 40 after Hurts stays upright and is hit while throwing by Jeffery Simmons.
Sacked on third down by Jacob Martin.
Catches a throw and is tackled by Woolen. Commentary separately identifies DeJean covering Robinson.
plays.defender_beaten: Woolen (tackler); DeJean covering Robinson, not identified as Tate's defender

plays.description: Comes down out of bounds on a deep attempt contested by Amani Hooker; incomplete.
Flushes left and throws the ball away as Tennessee collapses the pocket with four rushers.
Makes a long field goal.
Catches a first-down pass into the space vacated by Cooper DeJean's edge blitz.
plays.defender_beaten: Cooper DeJean (blitzer vacating the target area)

plays.description: Catches a play-action deep shot to Philadelphia's 30.
Holds onto a quick slant in front of Quinyon Mitchell.
Catches Ward's pass against pressure and lowers his shoulder near the sticks, setting up third-and-short.
Moves off a fake and dives for a touchdown. Commentary says Philadelphia initially covers the play-action.
Hurts steps up against pressure and throws to Mundt at the sideline; commentary says nothing is there but does not clearly establish the result.
Breaks a tackle before Quinyon Mitchell brings him down at the 39.
plays.defender_beaten: Quinyon Mitchell (final tackler); broken-tackle defender unknown

plays.description: Tennessee hurries to prevent substitutions; Ward throws incomplete to Tate while moving.
Catches a pass just past the sticks for a first down at the 41.
Gains a first down after Philadelphia has been backed up by holding.
Targeted on a screen that Harris stops; exact gain is unstated.
Hurts floats a pass toward D.Smith that Harris intercepts. Commentary credits Simmons with helping create the turnover; DB also names J.Simmons.
Starts the post-interception possession with an eight-yard run.
Catches a play-action deep pass, hurdles Marcus Epps and reaches inside Philadelphia's 25.
Breaks free past Epps for a long first-down run to Philadelphia's nine.
Keeps the ball, but Philadelphia is not fooled; exact result is unstated.

Runs left and barely reaches inside the 15 after tripping over teammate Peter Skoronski. Commentary identifies the same formation and play as the earlier long third-down run, without naming the formation.
Makes the go-ahead field goal.
Wins a downfield jump ball against Harris as Hurts delivers under Cody Barton pressure.
Catches a nine-yard pass during the final touchdown drive.
Catches another pass for first-and-goal; the clock stops with 14 seconds remaining.

Catches the winning touchdown at the back of the end zone after Hurts rolls right and buys time. Smith's out-and-in motion creates indecision among three defenders attempting to pass off man assignments.
plays.concept: rollout right; short middle pass; pre-snap motion
plays.personnel_formation: Smith motioned out and in; personnel grouping unknown

plays.description: Catches Ward's pass down the middle; Tennessee calls timeout with four seconds left.
Throws a deflected incompletion against a Philadelphia blitz on the final play.

offense_strengths: Wicks supplied the opening 27-yard gain, multiple captioned first-down catches and a 20-yard contested catch on the winning drive.
Smith repeatedly converted through the air, including a slant, middle and sideline completions, a 22-yard touchdown and two late-drive catches.
Hurts buying time enabled Smith's touchdown behind Hooker and Cooper's winning touchdown against explicitly identified Cover Zero.
Bigsby's middle runs showed power and patience near the goal line and produced a two-yard touchdown.
Smith's motion created defensive assignment indecision on Cooper's winning touchdown.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed consecutive 28-yard Ayomanor and 27-yard Spears receptions before Tennessee's halftime field goal.
DeJean's edge blitz vacated space that Ward exploited with a first-down completion to Robinson.
Allowed play-action gains of 25 yards to Ridley and 41 yards to Ayomanor.
Epps was hurdled on Ayomanor's 41-yard catch and beaten on Spears' 27-yard run.
Ward escaped pressure near the goal line and later scored on a scramble after Philadelphia initially covered the play-action.

offense_strengths: Ward's movement created a scramble to the one, a sneak touchdown and a later one-yard scrambling touchdown.
Play-action produced substantial gains to Ridley and Ayomanor.
Spears contributed a 27-yard reception and a 27-yard left-end run.
Pollard gained 13 yards behind multiple blockers from a two-back look and later opened a possession with an eight-yard run.
Ward found Robinson in space vacated by an edge blitz.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed repeated first-down completions to Smith and Wicks, including conversions against extra rushers.
Hooker was beaten behind the defense for Smith's 22-yard touchdown after Hurts extended the play.
Allowed Bigsby's powerful middle runs near the goal line, including a two-yard touchdown.
Harris surrendered Wicks' contested 20-yard catch to begin Philadelphia's winning possession.
Three defenders showed assignment indecision after Smith's motion, leaving Cooper open for the winning touchdown against Cover Zero.

limitations: Captions only; no routes, alignments, blocking assignments or coverage details were inferred from video. The supplied DB is a selected subset, so NO DB MATCH does not mean a play did not occur. Only caption-identifiable plays are listed; DB-only kickoffs, returns and other uncaptioned events are omitted. DB distances take precedence where clearly matched. For interceptions, yards denotes return distance; for field goals, kick distance. Null yards means the gain cannot be established. Named tacklers, interceptors and contesting defenders are labeled by role and are not necessarily defenders beaten. Unmatched names remain as captioned without speculative DB corrections. Pressure descriptions do not establish a coverage shell. The isolated swing-route fragment and retrospective references to earlier goal-line runs do not establish additional distinct plays.
